blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — International Criminal Court (ICC) prosecutors have requested the inclusion of two additional witnesses in the crimes against humanity case against former President Rodrigo Duterte to demonstrate “inconsistencies” in the Philippine National Police’s claims of self-defense during his administration’s “war on drugs.” Acting Prosecutor Mame Mandiaye Niang requested the formal submission of the statements, transcripts, and related materials of two witnesses identified only as P-0025 (female) and P-1382 (male).
